audience: vacation rental and short-term rental managers who run their listings and bookings in Hostaway

useCases.title: List upcoming check-ins and the properties they are at
useCases.text: The AI lists reservations filtered by arrival or departure window, listing or channel, with guest, dates, status and price, so you see who arrives when.

useCases.title: Quote a stay and check calendar availability
useCases.text: The AI reads a listing's day-by-day availability and nightly prices, and calculates the total for a stay with fees and taxes. Nothing is booked.

useCases.title: Review guest reviews and read guest messages
useCases.text: The AI lists reviews with rating, public review and host reply, and reads guest conversations, so you can see what guests say and who has not been answered.

useCases.title: Find out who changed a reservation
useCases.text: The AI reads the audit trail of one reservation, with each field change, the previous and new value, the time and the user.

useCases.title: Create a reservation, or block or price calendar days
useCases.text: The AI creates a direct reservation, which blocks the calendar, or blocks days and sets nightly price or minimum stay on a listing. Changes sync to connected channels.

useCases.title: Create or update a task, or message a guest
useCases.text: The AI creates a cleaning or maintenance task for a listing and reservation, updates its status, or sends a message to the guest in a conversation.
